exposure: Implementation of COVID-19 mitigation measures (March 9, March 15, March 23, 2020)
cohort: The study analyzed data from 1,599,547 singleton neonates from the national neonatal dried blood spot screening programme (2010-2020) in the Netherlands.
finding: Initial implementation of COVID-19 mitigation measures on March 9, 2020, was associated with a substantial reduction in the incidence of preterm births in the following months.
